## About
Cylinder Head Depot is a family-owned business. It started with our grandfather in the rebuilding business, and our father later took it over and specialized in rebuilding engines. When we came in, we focused on what we knew best, cylinder heads, changed the name to Cylinder Head Depot and invested in welding equipment, pressure testers and schooling on welding and crack repair.
Today we work on heads for the automotive, truck, marine, diesel, motorcycle and industrial industries from our shop on State Road 7 in Davie, in the heart of Broward County between Miami and West Palm Beach. We keep heads and parts in stock, and you can call or email us for pricing and availability.
Thank you to everyone who has trusted us with their work. Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 117 Google reviews. Steve and Greg

## Services
- Cylinder head rebuilding and repair: Rebuilding, repair, exchange and reconditioning of cylinder heads.
- Diamond resurfacing: Precision diamond resurfacing for cylinder heads.
- Performance valve jobs: Performance 3- and 5-angle valve jobs.
- Blocks bored, honed and decked: Boring, honing and decking for blocks.
- Welding and flywheel grinding: In-house welding and flywheel grinding.
- Diesel 6.0 and 6.4 cylinder heads: A specialty of the shop.
- Cleaning: Shot blasting and hydroblast cleaning.
- Press work: R & R of U Joints and press bushings.
- Gaskets, cams, valves and springs: Gasket sets, cams, valves, rockers and springs available at the counter.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of engines do you work on?
A: Cylinder heads for cars, trucks, boats, motorcycles, jet skis, forklifts and generators.

Q: How do I get a price?
A: Call the shop or send an email and we'll let you know pricing and availability.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
